key: ???: Hello challenger, and welcome.
en: ???: Hello challenger, and welcome.
ja: ???: ようこそ、挑戦者よ。

key: Please, follow me.
en: Please, follow me.
ja: どうぞ、こちらへ。

key: LUNA: Gardevoir! You're back!
en: LUNA: Gardevoir! You're back!
ja: ルナ: サーナイト! 戻ってきたのね!

key: GARDEVOIR: But of course, my dear~
en: GARDEVOIR: But of course, my dear~
ja: サーナイト: もちろんですとも、あなた~

key: LUNA: Oh, how I've missed you!
en: LUNA: Oh, how I've missed you!
ja: ルナ: ああ、寂しかったわ!

key: Now don't you go off disappearing like that again, please.
en: Now don't you go off disappearing like that again, please.
ja: もう、あんな風にいなくなったりしないでね、お願い。

key: GARDEVOIR: Pish posh~
en: GARDEVOIR: Pish posh~
ja: サーナイト: あらあら~

key: What's a girl without a little excitement in her life, hm?
en: What's a girl without a little excitement in her life, hm?
ja: 人生にちょっとした刺激がなくちゃ、女の子とは言えないでしょう?

key: Besides, I had my Gallade-in-shining-armor come all the way down to rescue me!
en: Besides, I had my Gallade-in-shining-armor come all the way down to rescue me!
ja: それに、輝くよろいのエルレイドが、わざわざ助けに来てくれましたのよ!

key: RADOMUS: There was hardly much rescuing involved, but indeed.
en: RADOMUS: There was hardly much rescuing involved, but indeed.
ja: ラドマス: それほど大した救出でもなかったが、まあその通りだ。

key: The perceived crisis has been averted.
en: The perceived crisis has been averted.
ja: 認識されていた危機は、回避された。

key: LUNA: Oh, Master, you are so wonderful!
en: LUNA: Oh, Master, you are so wonderful!
ja: ルナ: ああ、ご主人様、なんて素晴らしいのでしょう!

key: I am pleased to be in service to you.
en: I am pleased to be in service to you.
ja: あなたにお仕えできて、幸せです。

key: RADOMUS: Now, now. Let's not get ahead of ourselves.
en: RADOMUS: Now, now. Let's not get ahead of ourselves.
ja: ラドマス: まあまあ。先走らないようにしよう。

key: I am but a humble Gallade.
en: I am but a humble Gallade.
ja: 私はただの、つつましいエルレイドだよ。

key: CAIN: Speaking of which, why do you keep changing to all these silly hats?
en: CAIN: Speaking of which, why do you keep changing to all these silly hats?
ja: カイン: そういえば、なんでそんなバカみたいな帽子を次々着替えてるんだ?

key: RADOMUS: You wound me.
en: RADOMUS: You wound me.
ja: ラドマス: それは心外だな。

key: There's nothing silly about them.
en: There's nothing silly about them.
ja: これらは、少しも滑稽なものではない。

key: But to answer your question...
en: But to answer your question...
ja: だが、その問いに答えるならば……

key: Why not?
en: Why not?
ja: なぜいけない?

key: RADOMUS: I simply choose the right hat for the right job.
en: RADOMUS: I simply choose the right hat for the right job.
ja: ラドマス: 私はただ、適材適所の帽子を選んでいるだけだ。

key: Isn't that sensible?
en: Isn't that sensible?
ja: 理にかなっているだろう?

key: GARDEVOIR: I'm afraid the peasantry knows nothing of my master's divine taste in fashion.
en: GARDEVOIR: I'm afraid the peasantry knows nothing of my master's divine taste in fashion.
ja: サーナイト: 残念ながら、庶民には主人の神々しいファッションセンスなど、理解できないのですわ。

key: LUNA: I find them most amusing. Don't you think so?
en: LUNA: I find them most amusing. Don't you think so?
ja: ルナ: わたしは、とても素敵だと思うわ。あなたもそう思わない?

key: RADOMUS: Yes, well, speaking of nonsequitur transitions, I have somebody to introduce to you all.
en: RADOMUS: Yes, well, speaking of nonsequitur transitions, I have somebody to introduce to you all.
ja: ラドマス: さて、話は逸れるが、皆に紹介したい者がいる。

key: If you would be so kind as to step aside, \PN?
en: If you would be so kind as to step aside, \PN?
ja: \PN、少し脇によけてもらえるかね?

key: RADOMUS: Please, enter.
en: RADOMUS: Please, enter.
ja: ラドマス: どうぞ、お入り。

key: CAIN: ...Uhm.
en: CAIN: ...Uhm.
ja: カイン: ……あー。

key: LUNA: That's--
en: LUNA: That's--
ja: ルナ: それは――

key: RADOMUS: Everybody, I would like you to meet the estate's newest butler, Elias.
en: RADOMUS: Everybody, I would like you to meet the estate's newest butler, Elias.
ja: ラドマス: 皆、この屋敷の新しい執事、イライアスを紹介しよう。

key: ELIAS: I am pleased to serve.
en: ELIAS: I am pleased to serve.
ja: イライアス: お仕えできて光栄です。

key: Do let me know if there is anything I may do to make your stay with us more comfortable.
en: Do let me know if there is anything I may do to make your stay with us more comfortable.
ja: 滞在を快適にするために、何かできることがあれば、お申し付けください。

key: LUNA: Why...?
en: LUNA: Why...?
ja: ルナ: どうして……?

key: RADOMUS: Ah, dear Luna, you look as if you've seen a ghost.
en: RADOMUS: Ah, dear Luna, you look as if you've seen a ghost.
ja: ラドマス: おや、ルナ、まるで幽霊でも見たような顔をしているね。

key: CAIN: It's not a ghost she's seen.
en: CAIN: It's not a ghost she's seen.
ja: カイン: 彼女が見たのは、幽霊じゃない。

key: It's her father.
en: It's her father.
ja: 彼女の父親だ。

key: LUNA: I am confused by your words.
en: LUNA: I am confused by your words.
ja: ルナ: あなたの言っていること、よくわからないわ。

key: Master is my father, and none other.
en: Master is my father, and none other.
ja: ご主人様こそが、わたしの父。それ以外にはいません。

key: RADOMUS: Indeed, it is a strange thing to accuse our new attendant of.
en: RADOMUS: Indeed, it is a strange thing to accuse our new attendant of.
ja: ラドマス: なるほど、新しい従者に対して、奇妙な言いがかりだな。

key: Elias, do tell.
en: Elias, do tell.
ja: イライアス、答えてくれ。

key: Is this girl your daughter?
en: Is this girl your daughter?
ja: この娘は、お前の娘か?

key: ELIAS: She is not.
en: ELIAS: She is not.
ja: イライアス: 違います。

key: RADOMUS: And as she claims me to be her parent, I believe that this issue can be laid to rest.
en: RADOMUS: And as she claims me to be her parent, I believe that this issue can be laid to rest.
ja: ラドマス: そして、彼女は私を親だと主張しているのだから、この件はこれで片がついたと思うがね。

key: LUNA: ...I wish to leave.
en: LUNA: ...I wish to leave.
ja: ルナ: ……失礼するわ。

key: I beg your pardon.
en: I beg your pardon.
ja: 失礼いたします。

key: GARDEVOIR: Luna, darling! Come back--
en: GARDEVOIR: Luna, darling! Come back--
ja: サーナイト: ルナ、あなた! 戻ってきて――

key: Oh, dear.
en: Oh, dear.
ja: あら、まあ。

key: ELIAS: Have I offended?
en: ELIAS: Have I offended?
ja: イライアス: 何か、気に障ることを?

key: RADOMUS: Through no fault of your own, surely.
en: RADOMUS: Through no fault of your own, surely.
ja: ラドマス: お前のせいではないだろう、確かに。

key: Pay it no mind.
en: Pay it no mind.
ja: 気にすることはない。

key: I understand that you have procured a certain rare object.
en: I understand that you have procured a certain rare object.
ja: ある珍しい品を手に入れたと聞いているが。

key: Will you please give it to me?
en: Will you please give it to me?
ja: それを、私に渡してくれるかね?

key: ELIAS: Yes, my Lord.
en: ELIAS: Yes, my Lord.
ja: イライアス: はい、ご主人様。

key: I believe this is the object to which you refer.
en: I believe this is the object to which you refer.
ja: こちらが、おっしゃっている品かと存じます。

key: Elias handed over the Amethyst Pendant!
en: Elias handed over the Amethyst Pendant!
ja: イライアスはアメジストのペンダントを手渡した!

key: RADOMUS: That will be all. Dismissed.
en: RADOMUS: That will be all. Dismissed.
ja: ラドマス: それでよい。下がってよい。

key: ELIAS: Understood, my Lord.
en: ELIAS: Understood, my Lord.
ja: イライアス: かしこまりました、ご主人様。

key: CAIN: That's Anna's Pendant! El took it before--
en: CAIN: That's Anna's Pendant! El took it before--
ja: カイン: それ、アンナのペンダントだ! エルが前に取っていって――

key: RADOMUS: Yes, you did say something to that effect.
en: RADOMUS: Yes, you did say something to that effect.
ja: ラドマス: ああ、そのようなことを言っていたな。

key: I then meant to ask you, \PN, exactly how did you come by this object?
en: I then meant to ask you, \PN, exactly how did you come by this object?
ja: それで、\PN、君に聞きたかったのだが、この品を一体どうやって手に入れたのかね?

key: Of course, I should know better than to ask such a question to a player character with no dialogue.
en: Of course, I should know better than to ask such a question to a player character with no dialogue.
ja: もっとも、台詞を持たないプレイヤーキャラクターに、そんな質問をするほど愚かではないつもりだが。

key: So perhaps your friend will tell me.
en: So perhaps your friend will tell me.
ja: では、君の友人が教えてくれるかもしれないな。

key: CAIN: Wait, what did you just say?
en: CAIN: Wait, what did you just say?
ja: カイン: 待て、今何て言った?

key: RADOMUS: Will you tell me where this came from?
en: RADOMUS: Will you tell me where this came from?
ja: ラドマス: これがどこから来たのか、教えてくれるかね?

key: CAIN: It belongs to a friend of ours, and she'll be wanting that back, you know?
en: CAIN: It belongs to a friend of ours, and she'll be wanting that back, you know?
ja: カイン: それ、オレたちの友達のもんで、返してほしがってるんだけど?

key: RADOMUS: Such a precious thing to lose...
en: RADOMUS: Such a precious thing to lose...
ja: ラドマス: 失うには、あまりに大切な品だ……

key: Believe me, none could understand better than I.
en: Believe me, none could understand better than I.
ja: 信じてくれ、私ほどそれを理解できる者はいない。

key: But in understanding, it is with all my greatest sympathy that I will refuse to return it to you.
en: But in understanding, it is with all my greatest sympathy that I will refuse to return it to you.
ja: だが、理解した上で、深い同情とともに、私はこれを返すことを拒否させてもらう。

key: For just this once, I will implore you to acquiesce to me on faith alone.
en: For just this once, I will implore you to acquiesce to me on faith alone.
ja: 今回だけは、信頼だけを頼りに、私に従ってもらいたい。

key: I will keep this object, and you will not find your trust abused.
en: I will keep this object, and you will not find your trust abused.
ja: この品は私が預かるが、その信頼を裏切ることはないと約束しよう。

key: Now! Onto lighter matters!
en: Now! Onto lighter matters!
ja: さて! もっと軽い話に移ろうか!

key: I believe we have a Gym Battle to get under way, do we not?
en: I believe we have a Gym Battle to get under way, do we not?
ja: ジムバトルを始める必要があるのではないかね?

key: \PN, you will find the doors to the challenge hall open.
en: \PN, you will find the doors to the challenge hall open.
ja: \PN、挑戦の間のドアは開いているはずだ。

key: Best of luck to you.
en: Best of luck to you.
ja: 幸運を祈る。

key: CAIN: I'm beginning to doubt if siding with him was really the right thing to do.
en: CAIN: I'm beginning to doubt if siding with him was really the right thing to do.
ja: カイン: あいつの味方をしたのが、本当に正しかったのか、疑い始めてる。

key: He acts so strange, and just ran off with Anna's Pendant like that.
en: He acts so strange, and just ran off with Anna's Pendant like that.
ja: あんな変な態度で、アンナのペンダントをさっさと持って行っちまうし。

key: And the fact that Elias had it-- doesn't that mean that he was...
en: And the fact that Elias had it-- doesn't that mean that he was...
ja: それに、イライアスが持ってたってことは――つまり、あいつは……

key: ...Hm. This is weird.
en: ...Hm. This is weird.
ja: ……うーん。おかしいな。

key: RADOMUS: Through no fault of your own, surely. At ease. I'll have further instructions for you later.
en: RADOMUS: Through no fault of your own, surely. At ease. I'll have further instructions for you later.
ja: ラドマス: お前のせいではないだろう、確かに。休め。後でまた指示を出す。

key: CAIN: What are you even doing now?
en: CAIN: What are you even doing now?
ja: カイン: 今度は一体何やってんだよ?

key: RADOMUS: Doing?
en: RADOMUS: Doing?
ja: ラドマス: 何を、とは?

key: Merely dismissing my employee for a moment.
en: Merely dismissing my employee for a moment.
ja: 少し、従業員を下がらせているだけだよ。

key: CAIN: Nonono, you know what I mean!
en: CAIN: Nonono, you know what I mean!
ja: カイン: いやいやいや、言いたいことわかるだろ!

key: That's obviously El! Why are you making him do this?
en: That's obviously El! Why are you making him do this?
ja: それ明らかにエルだろ! なんであいつにこんなことさせてんだよ?

key: RADOMUS: El? How foolish.
en: RADOMUS: El? How foolish.
ja: ラドマス: エル? 馬鹿げたことを。

key: El despises me. He would never agree to work for me, much less address me as "My Lord".
en: El despises me. He would never agree to work for me, much less address me as "My Lord".
ja: エルは私を毛嫌いしている。私のために働くことなど決して承知しないだろう、ましてや「ご主人様」などと呼ぶはずもない。

key: This butler's name is 'Elias'.
en: This butler's name is 'Elias'.
ja: この執事の名は「イライアス」だ。

key: Do not be so blind as to let the similarity of the names confuse you.
en: Do not be so blind as to let the similarity of the names confuse you.
ja: 名前が似ているからといって、惑わされるほど愚かにならないことだ。

key: That would be altogether rude.
en: That would be altogether rude.
ja: それは、まったく失礼な話だろう。

key: CAIN: Uh huh.
en: CAIN: Uh huh.
ja: カイン: はいはい。

key: RADOMUS: Regardless, I do have a Gym Battle to fulfill.
en: RADOMUS: Regardless, I do have a Gym Battle to fulfill.
ja: ラドマス: いずれにせよ、こなすべきジムバトルがある。

key: I'm sure \PN must be getting impatient.
en: I'm sure \PN must be getting impatient.
ja: \PNも、もう待ちくたびれている頃だろう。

key: So, I will bid you adieu, and leave you to your strange notions.
en: So, I will bid you adieu, and leave you to your strange notions.
ja: それでは、失礼するとしよう。その奇妙な考えは、君に任せておく。

key: RADOMUS: The butler being El...
en: RADOMUS: The butler being El...
ja: ラドマス: 執事がエルだと……

key: Hah! And exactly how would I do such a thing?
en: Hah! And exactly how would I do such a thing?
ja: はっ! 一体どうやって、そんなことができるというのだ?

key: Really, what a foolish accusation...
en: Really, what a foolish accusation...
ja: まったく、なんと馬鹿げた言いがかりだ……

key: ???: My master will join us shortly.
en: ???: My master will join us shortly.
ja: ???: 主人は間もなく参ります。

key: Please, make yourself comfortable if--
en: Please, make yourself comfortable if--
ja: どうぞ、おくつろぎください、もし――

key: ???: Oh, well what's this?
en: ???: Oh, well what's this?
ja: ???: あら、これは一体?

key: A new challenger!
en: A new challenger!
ja: 新しい挑戦者ですわ!

key: ???: One Miss Gossip Gardevoir, at your service!
en: ???: One Miss Gossip Gardevoir, at your service!
ja: ???: ゴシップ・サーナイトと申しますわ、お役に立ちますことよ!

key: And don't worry, dear, autographs are always free of charge.
en: And don't worry, dear, autographs are always free of charge.
ja: それとご心配なく、あなた、サインはいつでも無料ですわ。

key: GARDEVOIR: Hm? Haven't you met a Pokémon that can communicate before?
en: GARDEVOIR: Hm? Haven't you met a Pokémon that can communicate before?
ja: サーナイト: あら? 会話できるポケモンに会ったことがありませんの?

key: ???: Indeed, Gardevoir is unique among her kind to be able to psychically project her thoughts in English.
en: ???: Indeed, Gardevoir is unique among her kind to be able to psychically project her thoughts in English.
ja: ???: 実は、このサーナイトは、テレパシーで自らの思考を言葉として投影できる、同族の中でも独特な存在です。

key: ???: I am Radomus, the lord of this Castle.
en: ???: I am Radomus, the lord of this Castle.
ja: ???: 私は、この城の主、ラドマスだ。

key: It is a pleasure to meet you, challenger.
en: It is a pleasure to meet you, challenger.
ja: お会いできて光栄だよ、挑戦者。

key: As she has already alluded to, this Gardevoir belongs to me.
en: As she has already alluded to, this Gardevoir belongs to me.
ja: 彼女がすでにほのめかした通り、このサーナイトは私のものだ。

key: You may have seen her on TV; she's managed quite the career.
en: You may have seen her on TV; she's managed quite the career.
ja: テレビで見たことがあるかもしれないな、なかなかのキャリアを築いている。

key: And this is my daughter, Luna.
en: And this is my daughter, Luna.
ja: そして、こちらが私の娘、ルナだ。

key: LUNA: As the Castle's maid, I welcome you.
en: LUNA: As the Castle's maid, I welcome you.
ja: ルナ: この城のメイドとして、歓迎いたします。

key: Please let me know if there is anything I can do to make your stay more comfortable.
en: Please let me know if there is anything I can do to make your stay more comfortable.
ja: 滞在を快適にするために、何かできることがあれば、お申し付けください。

key: RADOMUS: And you are \PN, is that not so?
en: RADOMUS: And you are \PN, is that not so?
ja: ラドマス: そして、君が\PNだね、そうだろう?

key: GARDEVOIR: Oh, don't look so surprised that Master knows who you are already~
en: GARDEVOIR: Oh, don't look so surprised that Master knows who you are already~
ja: サーナイト: あら、ご主人様がもうあなたのことをご存じでも、そんなに驚かないでくださいな~

key: After all, as Reborn's very own Gossip Gardevoir, it IS my business to know things.
en: After all, as Reborn's very own Gossip Gardevoir, it IS my business to know things.
ja: なにしろ、リボーン公認のゴシップ・サーナイトとして、物事を知っているのがわたくしの仕事ですもの。

key: I know all about your repeated raids on the Meteors, your involvement with the other Leaders...
en: I know all about your repeated raids on the Meteors, your involvement with the other Leaders...
ja: チームメテオへの度重なる襲撃も、他のリーダーたちとの関わりも、全部知っておりますの……

key: Even your little escapade from the Orphanage~
en: Even your little escapade from the Orphanage~
ja: 孤児院からのちょっとした脱走劇まで~

key: And how you apparently joined a street gang?
en: And how you apparently joined a street gang?
ja: それに、ストリートギャングに加わったって話まで?

key: That one caught me by surprise.
en: That one caught me by surprise.
ja: それにはさすがに驚きましたわ。

key: Didn't think you were the type...
en: Didn't think you were the type...
ja: そういうタイプだとは思ってませんでしたの……

key: Oh, but don't worry~
en: Oh, but don't worry~
ja: あら、でもご心配なく~

key: Your secrets are safe with me!
en: Your secrets are safe with me!
ja: あなたの秘密は、わたくしが守りますから!

key: RADOMUS: Let us not overestimate the value of that statement.
en: RADOMUS: Let us not overestimate the value of that statement.
ja: ラドマス: その発言の価値を、過大評価しない方がいいだろうね。

key: Nonetheless, \PN, I assume that you have come for your next Gym Battle.
en: Nonetheless, \PN, I assume that you have come for your next Gym Battle.
ja: それはさておき、\PN、次のジムバトルのために来たのだろう。

key: In that case,
en: In that case,
ja: それならば、

key: Gardevoir.
en: Gardevoir.
ja: サーナイト。

key: Luna.
en: Luna.
ja: ルナ。

key: Would you please excuse us?
en: Would you please excuse us?
ja: 少し席を外してくれるかね?

key: LUNA: Yes, Master.
en: LUNA: Yes, Master.
ja: ルナ: はい、ご主人様。

key: GARDEVOIR: Ooh, enjoying a private moment with the Master!
en: GARDEVOIR: Ooh, enjoying a private moment with the Master!
ja: サーナイト: あら、ご主人様との二人だけの時間ですわね!

key: How lucky for you~
en: How lucky for you~
ja: あなたも運がいいこと~

key: RADOMUS: Gardevoir.
en: RADOMUS: Gardevoir.
ja: ラドマス: サーナイト。

key: GARDEVOIR: Going~
en: GARDEVOIR: Going~
ja: サーナイト: 行きますわ~

key: RADOMUS: Gardevoir is lively, but mostly harmless.
en: RADOMUS: Gardevoir is lively, but mostly harmless.
ja: ラドマス: サーナイトは活発だが、大抵は無害だよ。

key: Feel free to pay her no mind.
en: Feel free to pay her no mind.
ja: 気にせずともよい。

key: That is not why I dismissed them, however.
en: That is not why I dismissed them, however.
ja: だが、二人を下がらせたのは、そのためではない。

key: I understand that you have met with Luna's father.
en: I understand that you have met with Luna's father.
ja: 君は、ルナの父親に会ったと聞いている。

key: That is, El.
en: That is, El.
ja: つまり、エルにだ。

key: Allow me to clarify one thing:
en: Allow me to clarify one thing:
ja: ひとつ、はっきりさせておこう:

key: Though I called Luna my daughter, she is most definitely not.
en: Though I called Luna my daughter, she is most definitely not.
ja: 私はルナを娘と呼んでいるが、彼女は間違いなく、私の娘ではない。

key: The Emerald Brooch she wears around her neck is proof enough of that.
en: The Emerald Brooch she wears around her neck is proof enough of that.
ja: 彼女が首にかけているエメラルドのブローチが、その何よりの証拠だ。

key: She appeared one day, and claimed me to be her father.
en: She appeared one day, and claimed me to be her father.
ja: ある日突然現れて、私を父だと言い張ったのだ。

key: Despite equal parts confusion and protest, she moved herself right in.
en: Despite equal parts confusion and protest, she moved herself right in.
ja: 困惑と抗議が半々の中、彼女は勝手に住み着いてしまった。

key: Of course, my own family is long-since gone, and it was a bit empty in here...
en: Of course, my own family is long-since gone, and it was a bit empty in here...
ja: もっとも、私自身の家族はとうの昔にいなくなり、ここは少し寂しかったものでね……

key: How could I to say 'no' to her?
en: How could I to say 'no' to her?
ja: 彼女に「否」と言えるはずもなかろう?

key: Indeed, it seems that she is just playing a part in some greater fantasy.
en: Indeed, it seems that she is just playing a part in some greater fantasy.
ja: 実際、彼女はより大きな空想の中で、ひとつの役を演じているだけのようだ。

key: She fancies herself a maid and a princess at once, and fills each role nicely.
en: She fancies herself a maid and a princess at once, and fills each role nicely.
ja: メイドであり、姫君でもあると自ら思い込み、そのどちらの役も見事に演じている。

key: She is a strange girl, and has been no small source of amusement and joy for both Gardevoir and I.
en: She is a strange girl, and has been no small source of amusement and joy for both Gardevoir and I.
ja: 不思議な娘だが、サーナイトにとっても、私にとっても、大きな楽しみと喜びの源になっている。

key: Of course, the two of them were fast friends too.
en: Of course, the two of them were fast friends too.
ja: もちろん、あの二人はすぐに仲良くなった。

key: It's not as if I can just dismiss her now.
en: It's not as if I can just dismiss her now.
ja: 今さら彼女を追い出すことなど、できはしない。

key: But tell me, what is your impression of El?
en: But tell me, what is your impression of El?
ja: だが、教えてくれ、エルについて、君はどう思った?

key: He has come calling more than once to reclaim her, but I have refused him.
en: He has come calling more than once to reclaim her, but I have refused him.
ja: 何度も彼女を取り戻しに来たが、私はそのたびに断っている。

key: I suspect there may have been some hint of abuse in her past, or else she would not have so fervently fled her birth-father.
en: I suspect there may have been some hint of abuse in her past, or else she would not have so fervently fled her birth-father.
ja: 彼女の過去には、何らかの虐待の兆候があったのではないかと疑っている。そうでなければ、実の父親からあれほど必死に逃げるはずがない。

key: To that end, I am resolved to protect her from him.
en: To that end, I am resolved to protect her from him.
ja: それゆえ、私は彼女を彼から守ると決めている。

key: That is the long and the short of the affair.
en: That is the long and the short of the affair.
ja: それが、この件のあらましだ。

key: LUNA: Master?
en: LUNA: Master?
ja: ルナ: ご主人様?

key: Pardon the interruption.
en: Pardon the interruption.
ja: お邪魔して申し訳ありません。

key: We have another guest.
en: We have another guest.
ja: もう一人、お客様がいらしています。

key: RADOMUS: By all means, please show them in.
en: RADOMUS: By all means, please show them in.
ja: ラドマス: もちろん、お通ししなさい。

key: RADOMUS: I don't suppose you were expecting anyone?
en: RADOMUS: I don't suppose you were expecting anyone?
ja: ラドマス: 君も、誰かを待っていたわけではないのだろう?

key: CAIN: \PN!
en: CAIN: \PN!
ja: カイン: \PN!

key: Hayy gurl, hayyyy.
en: Hayy gurl, hayyyy.
ja: よぉ~、元気してた~?

key: RADOMUS: Welcome.
en: RADOMUS: Welcome.
ja: ラドマス: ようこそ。

key: I suppose you, too, have come for a Gym Battle?
en: I suppose you, too, have come for a Gym Battle?
ja: 君も、ジムバトルのために来たのかな?

key: CAIN: Yep.
en: CAIN: Yep.
ja: カイン: そうだぜ。

key: I've got some catching up to do, huh, \PN?
en: I've got some catching up to do, huh, \PN?
ja: オレも追いつかないとな、な、\PN?

key: Totally got side-tracked by that whole business with Heather.
en: Totally got side-tracked by that whole business with Heather.
ja: ヘザーの件で、すっかり寄り道しちまってさ。

key: I did manage to find her again...
en: I did manage to find her again...
ja: 結局、また見つけたんだけどな……

key: Not that she was happy about it.
en: Not that she was happy about it.
ja: あいつはあんまり喜んでなかったけど。

key: Apparently she was adopted by some guy in Ametrine City.
en: Apparently she was adopted by some guy in Ametrine City.
ja: アメトリンシティの誰かに、養子として引き取られたらしくてさ。

key: I think his name was Blake?
en: I think his name was Blake?
ja: 名前はたしか、ブレイクだったかな?

key: So that's good enough for me~
en: So that's good enough for me~
ja: まあ、それでオレは十分だぜ~

key: Long as she's happy.
en: Long as she's happy.
ja: あいつが幸せなら、それでいい。

key: RADOMUS: Well now, there are lost girls all over the place, are there?
en: RADOMUS: Well now, there are lost girls all over the place, are there?
ja: ラドマス: なるほど、迷子の少女というのは、あちこちにいるものだね?

key: LUNA: I beg your pardon?
en: LUNA: I beg your pardon?
ja: ルナ: 何のお話でしょう?

key: RADOMUS: But we now have two challengers, and only one Gym.
en: RADOMUS: But we now have two challengers, and only one Gym.
ja: ラドマス: だが、挑戦者は二人になったのに、ジムはひとつしかない。

key: CAIN: Easy, \PN and I will take you on together and then we both get the Badge!
en: CAIN: Easy, \PN and I will take you on together and then we both get the Badge!
ja: カイン: 簡単だろ、オレと\PNで一緒に挑んで、二人ともバッジもらえばいい!

key: RADOMUS: If only, if only.
en: RADOMUS: If only, if only.
ja: ラドマス: そうであればいいのだがね。

key: But could you play any real strategy with two minds on one side of the board?
en: But could you play any real strategy with two minds on one side of the board?
ja: だが、盤の片側に二つの意志があって、まともな戦略が組めるかね?

key: When the king knows not what the queen is doing, the whole kingdom falls into disarray.
en: When the king knows not what the queen is doing, the whole kingdom falls into disarray.
ja: 王が女王の動きを知らねば、王国全体が混乱に陥る。

key: Soon after, checkmate.
en: Soon after, checkmate.
ja: そして間もなく、チェックメイトだ。

key: LUNA: Master has amassed his fortune by winning chess tournaments all across the globe.
en: LUNA: Master has amassed his fortune by winning chess tournaments all across the globe.
ja: ルナ: ご主人様は、世界中のチェス大会で優勝することで、財を築かれたのです。

key: He is quite admirable, don't you think?
en: He is quite admirable, don't you think?
ja: 本当に立派な方だと思いませんか?

key: CAIN: I was just kidding anyway~
en: CAIN: I was just kidding anyway~
ja: カイン: まあ、冗談だったんだけどな~

key: How about this-- \PN and I battle to see who challenges first, yeah?
en: How about this-- \PN and I battle to see who challenges first, yeah?
ja: こうしないか――オレと\PNでバトルして、先に挑戦する方を決めよう、な?

key: RADOMUS: You may settle it however you wish.
en: RADOMUS: You may settle it however you wish.
ja: ラドマス: 好きなように決めるがよい。

key: CAIN: A romp with \PN is always good fun~
en: CAIN: A romp with \PN is always good fun~
ja: カイン: \PNとのバトルは、いつだって楽しいからな~

key: Come on, let's do it!
en: Come on, let's do it!
ja: さあ、やろうぜ!

key: 's cool, I can wait my turn. Just don't keep me on edge too long~
en: 's cool, I can wait my turn. Just don't keep me on edge too long~
ja: いいよ、順番は待つからさ。あんまり　じらさないでね～

key: CAIN: Uhhh, wow!
en: CAIN: Uhhh, wow!
ja: カイン: うわぁ、すげえ!

key: I'll be honest, I wasn't sure half of what was going on in that battle...
en: I'll be honest, I wasn't sure half of what was going on in that battle...
ja: 正直、あのバトル、半分くらい何が起きてるのかわかんなかったよ……

key: Guess I'll have to read up on how this arena works?
en: Guess I'll have to read up on how this arena works?
ja: このアリーナの仕組み、調べないとダメかもな?

key: Soften him up for me in the mean time, yeah~?
en: Soften him up for me in the mean time, yeah~?
ja: それまでに、こいつを弱らせといてくれよ、な~?

key: RADOMUS: Oh? Do you not believe you can best me yourself?
en: RADOMUS: Oh? Do you not believe you can best me yourself?
ja: ラドマス: おや? 自分では私に勝てないと思っているのかね?

key: LUNA: Excuse me, Master?
en: LUNA: Excuse me, Master?
ja: ルナ: 失礼します、ご主人様?

key: Is Miss Gardevoir with you?
en: Is Miss Gardevoir with you?
ja: サーナイトさんは、そちらにいらっしゃいますか?

key: I cannot find her anywhere.
en: I cannot find her anywhere.
ja: どこにも見当たらなくて。

key: RADOMUS: I thought she was with you.
en: RADOMUS: I thought she was with you.
ja: ラドマス: お前と一緒だと思っていたが。

key: LUNA: She was in the foyer when Cain arrived.
en: LUNA: She was in the foyer when Cain arrived.
ja: ルナ: カインが到着した時は、玄関の間にいらしたんですけど。

key: RADOMUS: It would seem that I'll be playing Black this game.
en: RADOMUS: It would seem that I'll be playing Black this game.
ja: ラドマス: この一局は、私が後手を引くことになりそうだ。

key: LUNA: Master? A message was delivered for you.
en: LUNA: Master? A message was delivered for you.
ja: ルナ: ご主人様? あなた宛てに、伝言が届いています。

key: RADOMUS: A message?
en: RADOMUS: A message?
ja: ラドマス: 伝言?

key: Now who might that be?
en: Now who might that be?
ja: さて、誰からだろうな?

key: LUNA: The person who delivered it was dressed in a light robe, but I didn't recognize him.
en: LUNA: The person who delivered it was dressed in a light robe, but I didn't recognize him.
ja: ルナ: 届けに来た方は、軽装のローブを着ていましたが、見覚えのない方でした。

key: RADOMUS: Allow me to see it.
en: RADOMUS: Allow me to see it.
ja: ラドマス: 見せてもらえるかね。

key: LUNA: Pleased to be of service.
en: LUNA: Pleased to be of service.
ja: ルナ: お役に立てて光栄です。

key: RADOMUS: "To one Radomus Vanhanen--"
en: RADOMUS: "To one Radomus Vanhanen--"
ja: ラドマス: 「ラドマス・ヴァンハネン殿へ――」

key: To one?
en: To one?
ja: 「一人の」?

key: Does that imply there's more than one?
en: Does that imply there's more than one?
ja: 他にもいるということかな?

key: I should like to meet the other.
en: I should like to meet the other.
ja: もう一人がいるなら、会ってみたいものだ。

key: "To one Radomus Vanhanen, I have captured your precious 'Gossip Gardevoir'.
en: "To one Radomus Vanhanen, I have captured your precious 'Gossip Gardevoir'.
ja: 「ラドマス・ヴァンハネン殿へ。あなたの大切な『ゴシップ・サーナイト』を捕らえた。

key: Should you wish to see her again, you will return my daughter to me immediately."
en: Should you wish to see her again, you will return my daughter to me immediately."
ja: 再び会いたければ、直ちに私の娘を返してもらおう。」

key: Signed, "-El"
en: Signed, "-El"
ja: 署名、「―エル」

key: What, no "Sincerely"?
en: What, no "Sincerely"?
ja: なんだ、「敬具」もなしか?

key: Not even a "With love"?
en: Not even a "With love"?
ja: 「愛を込めて」すらないとは?

key: How rude.
en: How rude.
ja: なんと無礼な。

key: LUNA: ...That person isn't my father.
en: LUNA: ...That person isn't my father.
ja: ルナ: ……あの方は、わたしの父ではありません。

key: You are.
en: You are.
ja: あなたが父です。

key: I wish he would simply admit this already...
en: I wish he would simply admit this already...
ja: あの方も、もういい加減それを認めてくれればいいのに……

key: I beg of you, Master, please don't send me away with him.
en: I beg of you, Master, please don't send me away with him.
ja: お願いです、ご主人様、わたしをあの方のもとへ送らないでください。

key: CAIN: She was really just captured?
en: CAIN: She was really just captured?
ja: カイン: 本当に、たった今捕まったのか?

key: But she was like, right there when we came in.
en: But she was like, right there when we came in.
ja: でも、オレたちが来た時、確かにそこにいたじゃん。

key: RADOMUS: It was likely that they were waiting for such a diversion as your battle.
en: RADOMUS: It was likely that they were waiting for such a diversion as your battle.
ja: ラドマス: おそらく、君たちのバトルのような気を逸らす機会を、待っていたのだろう。

key: Just as well.
en: Just as well.
ja: ちょうどよかった、というわけだ。

key: CAIN: We've gotta get her back right away!
en: CAIN: We've gotta get her back right away!
ja: カイン: すぐに取り返しに行かないと!

key: LUNA: Absolutely!
en: LUNA: Absolutely!
ja: ルナ: その通りです!

key: Miss Gardevoir is my dear friend as well.
en: Miss Gardevoir is my dear friend as well.
ja: サーナイトさんは、わたしの大切な友人でもあります。

key: You will find her, won't you, Master?
en: You will find her, won't you, Master?
ja: 見つけてくださいますよね、ご主人様?

key: RADOMUS: Hm.
en: RADOMUS: Hm.
ja: ラドマス: ふむ。

key: CAIN: Don't worry, we'll take care of it~
en: CAIN: Don't worry, we'll take care of it~
ja: カイン: 心配すんな、オレたちが何とかするから~

key: Right, \PN?
en: Right, \PN?
ja: だよな、\PN?

key: LUNA: But how?
en: LUNA: But how?
ja: ルナ: でも、どうやって?

key: We have no idea where they went.
en: We have no idea where they went.
ja: どこへ行ったのか、まったくわかりません。

key: What do we do?
en: What do we do?
ja: どうすれば?

key: RADOMUS: Nothing.
en: RADOMUS: Nothing.
ja: ラドマス: 何も。

key: RADOMUS: There is no need to do anything.
en: RADOMUS: There is no need to do anything.
ja: ラドマス: 何もする必要はない。

key: CAIN: What are you talking about?
en: CAIN: What are you talking about?
ja: カイン: 何言ってんだ?

key: She's your Pokémon; don't you care at all?
en: She's your Pokémon; don't you care at all?
ja: あんたのポケモンだろ、気にならないのかよ?

key: RADOMUS: Of course I do.
en: RADOMUS: Of course I do.
ja: ラドマス: もちろん、気にかけているとも。

key: It's for that reason that I need not act.
en: It's for that reason that I need not act.
ja: だからこそ、行動する必要がないのだ。

key: CAIN: Uggh, you make no sense at all sometimes.
en: CAIN: Uggh, you make no sense at all sometimes.
ja: カイン: うわ、時々マジで意味わかんねえよな、あんた。

key: I'll go find her myself then!
en: I'll go find her myself then!
ja: だったら、オレが自分で見つけに行く!

key: LUNA: Please wait-- I wish to help as well!
en: LUNA: Please wait-- I wish to help as well!
ja: ルナ: お待ちください――わたしもお手伝いしたいです!

key: RADOMUS: Luna.
en: RADOMUS: Luna.
ja: ラドマス: ルナ。

key: It will not do to let you place yourself in check.
en: It will not do to let you place yourself in check.
ja: お前を、王手にかかる位置に置くわけにはいかない。

key: You are the piece he wants to capture, after all.
en: You are the piece he wants to capture, after all.
ja: なにしろ、彼が捕らえたい駒は、お前なのだからね。

key: If you are so determined, allow me to act in your stead.
en: If you are so determined, allow me to act in your stead.
ja: それほど強く望むなら、私がお前の代わりに動こう。

key: RADOMUS: I'm on the case.
en: RADOMUS: I'm on the case.
ja: ラドマス: 私が対処する。

key: Do wait here.
en: Do wait here.
ja: ここで待っていなさい。

key: It will not do to let yourself fall into his trap.
en: It will not do to let yourself fall into his trap.
ja: 自ら奴のわなに落ちるようなことがあってはならない。

key: LUNA: She simply must be all right...
en: LUNA: She simply must be all right...
ja: ルナ: きっと、無事に決まっています……

key: Gardevoir has been a dedicated companion to me.
en: Gardevoir has been a dedicated companion to me.
ja: サーナイトさんは、わたしにとって献身的な友でした。

key: Whether it were here or at my mother's house, she was delighted to escort me wherever I went.
en: Whether it were here or at my mother's house, she was delighted to escort me wherever I went.
ja: ここでも、母の家でも、わたしがどこへ行くにも、喜んで付き添ってくれました。

key: I felt quite a bit safer with her, and yet...
en: I felt quite a bit safer with her, and yet...
ja: 一緒にいると、とても安心できたのに……

key: How could it be that she's been beset by this evil now instead?
en: How could it be that she's been beset by this evil now instead?
ja: それなのに、どうしてあの方が、あの邪悪なものに苦しめられることになったのでしょう?

key: Perhaps I should never have left her side.
en: Perhaps I should never have left her side.
ja: そばを離れるべきではなかったのかもしれません。

key: But then, everyone has two sides, and it is impossible to stay by each of them at once.
en: But then, everyone has two sides, and it is impossible to stay by each of them at once.
ja: でも、誰にでも二つの面があって、その両方に同時にそばにいることなんてできないのですよね。

key: LUNA: How is everything?
en: LUNA: How is everything?
ja: ルナ: 皆さん、どうですか?

key: Why haven't the others returned?
en: Why haven't the others returned?
ja: どうして、他の方々はまだ戻ってこないんでしょう?

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: 鍵がかかっている。

key: CAIN: So you swapped one silly hat for another.
en: CAIN: So you swapped one silly hat for another.
ja: カイン: それで、バカな帽子を別のバカな帽子に着替えたわけか。

key: RADOMUS: Now, now...
en: RADOMUS: Now, now...
ja: ラドマス: まあまあ……

key: There's nothing silly about it.
en: There's nothing silly about it.
ja: これも、少しも滑稽なものではないよ。

key: I simply choose the right hat for the job.
en: I simply choose the right hat for the job.
ja: 私はただ、適材適所の帽子を選んでいるだけだ。

key: Will we not be sleuthing out Gardevoir?
en: Will we not be sleuthing out Gardevoir?
ja: サーナイトを探偵よろしく探すのではないかね?

key: CAIN: Yeaaaah, quite the change of heart you've had.
en: CAIN: Yeaaaah, quite the change of heart you've had.
ja: カイン: いやぁ、ずいぶんと心変わりしたもんだな。

key: RADOMUS: Do not misunderstand me.
en: RADOMUS: Do not misunderstand me.
ja: ラドマス: 誤解しないでもらいたい。

key: There is no need for something as rash as this, but if Luna demands it, I will acquiesce.
en: There is no need for something as rash as this, but if Luna demands it, I will acquiesce.
ja: こんな軽率なことをする必要はないのだが、ルナが望むなら、私は従うまでだ。

key: CAIN: I don't get it.
en: CAIN: I don't get it.
ja: カイン: わけわかんねえよ。

key: I thought Gardevoir were supposed to only be drawn to the most loyal Trainers, but you make it seem like you don't care at all.
en: I thought Gardevoir were supposed to only be drawn to the most loyal Trainers, but you make it seem like you don't care at all.
ja: サーナイトって、一番忠実なトレーナーにしか懐かないはずなのに、あんたはまるで全然気にしてないみたいに見せるんだもんな。

key: RADOMUS: Should Black be concerned when the White King places himself in check?
en: RADOMUS: Should Black be concerned when the White King places himself in check?
ja: ラドマス: 白の王が自ら王手にかかった時、黒が動揺する必要があるかね?

key: CAIN: Literally what are you even talking about?
en: CAIN: Literally what are you even talking about?
ja: カイン: マジで何言ってんのか、さっぱりわかんねえ。

key: Look, let's just go find her already.
en: Look, let's just go find her already.
ja: とにかく、もうさっさと探しに行こうぜ。

key: RADOMUS: As you wish.
en: RADOMUS: As you wish.
ja: ラドマス: お望みのままに。

key: Considering his past associations, I suspect he will flee in the direction of Reborn City.
en: Considering his past associations, I suspect he will flee in the direction of Reborn City.
ja: 彼の過去の関わりを考えると、リボーンシティの方角に逃げるだろうと私は見ている。

key: CAIN: Right, then we know where to go.
en: CAIN: Right, then we know where to go.
ja: カイン: よし、じゃあ行き先はわかったな。

key: The quickest way there is west and then south over Route 1.
en: The quickest way there is west and then south over Route 1.
ja: そこへの最短ルートは、西へ、それから1番道路を南へ。

key: Let's do this!
en: Let's do this!
ja: やってやろうぜ!

key: The quickest way there is east and then south over Route 1.
en: The quickest way there is east and then south over Route 1.
ja: そこへの最短ルートは、東へ、それから1番道路を南へ。

key: CAIN: I'm really kind of not comfortable with this.
en: CAIN: I'm really kind of not comfortable with this.
ja: カイン: これ、正直あんまり気分良くないな。

key: And I'm normally comfortable with a lot of things most people aren't comfortable with~
en: And I'm normally comfortable with a lot of things most people aren't comfortable with~
ja: 普通の人が気にするようなことでも、オレは大抵平気なタイプなのにな~

key: ELIAS: Well met, young Master. Please, follow me.
en: ELIAS: Well met, young Master. Please, follow me.
ja: イライアス: お会いできて何より、若様。どうぞ、ついてきてください。

key: I have already secured an escape route from our assailants.
en: I have already secured an escape route from our assailants.
ja: 襲撃者から逃れる経路は、すでに確保しております。

key: This way, swiftly.
en: This way, swiftly.
ja: こちらへ、急いで。

key: METEOR: Got 'em!
en: METEOR: Got 'em!
ja: メテオ団員: 捕まえたぞ!

key: ELIAS: As they say, "Checkmate."
en: ELIAS: As they say, "Checkmate."
ja: イライアス: よく言うでしょう、「チェックメイト」と。

key: ELIAS: But surely you are not surprised?
en: ELIAS: But surely you are not surprised?
ja: イライアス: しかし、驚いてはおられないでしょう?

key: ELIAS: Of course I would not have remained under the swine's spell for long.
en: ELIAS: Of course I would not have remained under the swine's spell for long.
ja: イライアス: もちろん、あの豚の術に、私が長く囚われ続けるはずもありません。

key: I'm sure he counted on as much.
en: I'm sure he counted on as much.
ja: あの男も、それは織り込み済みだったはずです。

key: He hypnotized me and bade me act his butler firstly out of spite,
en: He hypnotized me and bade me act his butler firstly out of spite,
ja: 私に催眠術をかけ、執事を演じさせたのは、まず第一に悪意から、

key: And secondly to illustrate a point.
en: And secondly to illustrate a point.
ja: 第二に、ある論点を示すためでした。

key: If it wears off of me so quickly, how then could my daughter be still taken in?
en: If it wears off of me so quickly, how then could my daughter be still taken in?
ja: これほど早く私にかけた術が解けるのなら、なぜ娘は未だに欺かれたままなのか、というわけです。

key: It is a compelling argument.
en: It is a compelling argument.
ja: なかなか説得力のある論法ですな。

key: Clearly she is of her own mind, and yet still she defies me.
en: Clearly she is of her own mind, and yet still she defies me.
ja: 彼女は明らかに自らの意志を持っているのに、それでも私に逆らい続けている。

key: His miscalculation was that such a revelation might deter my efforts.
en: His miscalculation was that such a revelation might deter my efforts.
ja: あの男の誤算は、この事実が私の努力をくじくだろうと思い込んだことです。

key: On the contrary, it has made clear that it is now, more than ever, necessary to extricate her.
en: On the contrary, it has made clear that it is now, more than ever, necessary to extricate her.
ja: それどころか、今まで以上に彼女を救い出す必要があると、はっきりしただけのこと。

key: ELIAS: Of course, I'll suffer none to stand in my way.
en: ELIAS: Of course, I'll suffer none to stand in my way.
ja: イライアス: もちろん、私の邪魔をする者は、誰であろうと容赦しません。

key: Though it's hardly only my way you've been in now, is it?
en: Though it's hardly only my way you've been in now, is it?
ja: もっとも、あなた方が邪魔しているのは、私の道だけではないでしょう?

key: Solaris has told me all I need to know about your impudent meddling with Team Meteor.
en: Solaris has told me all I need to know about your impudent meddling with Team Meteor.
ja: ソラリスから、あなた方がチームメテオに対して働いた、不遜なお節介について、必要なことはすべて聞いております。

key: I shall not permit you to interfere with their divine purpose.
en: I shall not permit you to interfere with their divine purpose.
ja: 彼らの神聖な目的への干渉は、断じて許しません。

key: Eradicate the unclean city, restore the ruin below it to greatness...
en: Eradicate the unclean city, restore the ruin below it to greatness...
ja: けがれた街を一掃し、その下に眠る遺跡を、かつての栄光へと取り戻す……

key: To all who would thwart that design, judgment shall--
en: To all who would thwart that design, judgment shall--
ja: その計画を阻もうとする者すべてに、裁きが――

key: ???: Nidoking!
en: ???: Nidoking!
ja: ???: ニドキング!

key: CAIN: \PN, they caught Luna!
en: CAIN: \PN, they caught Luna!
ja: カイン: \PN、ルナが捕まった!

key: It was that harlequin again-- Ace!
en: It was that harlequin again-- Ace!
ja: またあの道化師だ――エースだ!

key: ELIAS: They should have captured you as well.
en: ELIAS: They should have captured you as well.
ja: イライアス: あなたも捕らえるべきだったのですが。

key: CAIN: Yeah, well, I don't go down without a fight, or at least some sweet talk first.
en: CAIN: Yeah, well, I don't go down without a fight, or at least some sweet talk first.
ja: カイン: まあな、オレは戦いもせず、少なくとも先に口説きもせずに、大人しくやられたりしないんでな。

key: ELIAS: Your lecherous implications only condemn you further.
en: ELIAS: Your lecherous implications only condemn you further.
ja: イライアス: そのいやらしい物言いが、あなたをさらに不利にするだけです。

key: Do you believe that even the two of you together can best me?
en: Do you believe that even the two of you together can best me?
ja: あなた方二人そろっても、私に勝てるとでも?

key: CAIN: Wanna find out?
en: CAIN: Wanna find out?
ja: カイン: 確かめてみるか?

key: ELIAS: Do not mistake my little experiment of drawing on our Lord Arceus' power as the limit of my own ability.
en: ELIAS: Do not mistake my little experiment of drawing on our Lord Arceus' power as the limit of my own ability.
ja: イライアス: アルセウス様の力を借りた、あの小さな実験を、私自身の力の限界だと勘違いなさらぬように。

key: CAIN: Your ability doesn't matter right now.
en: CAIN: Your ability doesn't matter right now.
ja: カイン: あんたの実力なんて、今はどうでもいい。

key: I know what I gotta do.
en: I know what I gotta do.
ja: オレがやるべきことは、わかってる。

key: Cuz I know that \PN's team is all messed up from that Gym Battle.
en: Cuz I know that \PN's team is all messed up from that Gym Battle.
ja: だって、\PNの手持ちが、さっきのジムバトルでボロボロなの、わかってるからな。

key: That's why you waited to act until now, right?
en: That's why you waited to act until now, right?
ja: だから、今まで動くのを待ってたんだろ?

key: So I'll fight you myself.
en: So I'll fight you myself.
ja: だから、オレが自分で戦う。

key: \PN surpassed me a long time ago, so even if I do lose, it doesn't matter.
en: \PN surpassed me a long time ago, so even if I do lose, it doesn't matter.
ja: \PNはとっくの昔にオレを超えてるし、オレが負けたって、それは関係ない。

key: So you go on, \PN. I'll hold him up while you get out of here.
en: So you go on, \PN. I'll hold him up while you get out of here.
ja: だから\PN、お前は先に行け。オレがこいつを足止めしとくから、その間に逃げろ。

key: Rescuing Luna's up to you now, 'kay?
en: Rescuing Luna's up to you now, 'kay?
ja: ルナを救うのは、もうお前次第だ、いいな?

key: ELIAS: How noble a sacrifice.
en: ELIAS: How noble a sacrifice.
ja: イライアス: なんとも高貴な自己犠牲だ。

key: You know who I am, don't you?
en: You know who I am, don't you?
ja: 私が何者か、わかっているのでしょう?

key: CAIN: Yup, I realized it after I heard your real name.
en: CAIN: Yup, I realized it after I heard your real name.
ja: カイン: ああ、本当の名前を聞いて気づいたよ。

key: You're one of the Elite Four.
en: You're one of the Elite Four.
ja: あんた、エリートフォーの一人だろ。

key: ELIAS: Then you will understand there will be no "sweet talk".
en: ELIAS: Then you will understand there will be no "sweet talk".
ja: イライアス: それなら、「口説き」など通用しないことも、おわかりでしょう。

key: You will bow before the Lord.
en: You will bow before the Lord.
ja: あなたは、主の御前にひれ伏すことになります。

key: CHESHIRE: Breon.
en: CHESHIRE: Breon.
ja: チェシャ: ブラー。

key: Pet Cheshire?
en: Pet Cheshire?
ja: チェシャをなでますか?

key: UMBREON: Breon.
en: UMBREON: Breon.
ja: ブラッキー: ブラー。

key: Pet Umbreon?
en: Pet Umbreon?
ja: ブラッキーをなでますか?

key: CHESHIRE: Umbreon.
en: CHESHIRE: Umbreon.
ja: チェシャ: ブラッキー。

key: It hardly reacts. Maybe it liked it?
en: It hardly reacts. Maybe it liked it?
ja: ほとんど反応しない。気に入ったのだろうか?

key: It doesn't seem to care.
en: It doesn't seem to care.
ja: 気にしていないようだ。

key: Cheshire doesn't say anything.
en: Cheshire doesn't say anything.
ja: チェシャは何も言わない。

key: It still doesn't react, but you seem to feel it press into your hand a little bit.
en: It still doesn't react, but you seem to feel it press into your hand a little bit.
ja: 相変わらず反応はないが、手に少し体を押し付けてくるのを感じる。

key: Cheshire still doesn't care and keeps doing what it was doing.
en: Cheshire still doesn't care and keeps doing what it was doing.
ja: チェシャは相変わらず気にせず、自分のしていたことを続けている。

key: NOEL: Checkmate.
en: NOEL: Checkmate.
ja: ノエル: チェックメイト。

key: RADOMUS: What?
en: RADOMUS: What?
ja: ラドマス: 何?

key: Nonsense.
en: Nonsense.
ja: ばかな。

key: The knight blocks.
en: The knight blocks.
ja: ナイトで防げる。

key: NOEL: The knight blocks.
en: NOEL: The knight blocks.
ja: ノエル: ナイトで防いだとしても。

key: Then I go here.
en: Then I go here.
ja: 僕はここに動く。

key: Your only move is here.
en: Your only move is here.
ja: あなたの動ける場所は、ここしかない。

key: Here.
en: Here.
ja: ここだ。

key: You go here.
en: You go here.
ja: あなたはここに動く。

key: And then the bishop.
en: And then the bishop.
ja: それから、ビショップ。

key: RADOMUS: ...
en: RADOMUS: ...
ja: ラドマス: ……

key: ...No, no, I can move here instead on the turn before.
en: ...No, no, I can move here instead on the turn before.
ja: ……いや、いや、その前の手で、ここに動けるはずだ。

key: NOEL: Knight.
en: NOEL: Knight.
ja: ノエル: ナイト。

key: RADOMUS: ...Blast.
en: RADOMUS: ...Blast.
ja: ラドマス: ……くそ。

key: NOEL: A more accurate play would be to push this pawn the turn prior.
en: NOEL: A more accurate play would be to push this pawn the turn prior.
ja: ノエル: もっと正確に打つなら、その前の手でこのポーンを進めるべきだった。

key: RADOMUS: How did you see that...
en: RADOMUS: How did you see that...
ja: ラドマス: どうやって、それが見えたんだ……

key: NOEL: It's not a matter of seeing it.
en: NOEL: It's not a matter of seeing it.
ja: ノエル: 見える見えないの話じゃない。

key: It's a matter of knowing it.
en: It's a matter of knowing it.
ja: 知っているかどうかの話だ。

key: Just because you can't see it doesn't mean it's not there.
en: Just because you can't see it doesn't mean it's not there.
ja: 見えないからといって、そこに無いわけじゃない。

key: RADOMUS: ...Indeed.
en: RADOMUS: ...Indeed.
ja: ラドマス: ……確かにな。

key: You see how amazing he is?
en: You see how amazing he is?
ja: どれだけこの子がすごいか、わかったかね?

key: I told you.
en: I told you.
ja: 言った通りだろう。

key: NOEL: It's not that amazing.
en: NOEL: It's not that amazing.
ja: ノエル: そんなにすごくない。

key: RADOMUS: Well, look here-- I only may be a Grandmaster through forged records and stolen identity, but neither am I quite so near the bottom.
en: RADOMUS: Well, look here-- I only may be a Grandmaster through forged records and stolen identity, but neither am I quite so near the bottom.
ja: ラドマス: まあ、聞きなさい――私はグランドマスターの座を、偽造記録と盗んだ身分で得たにすぎないかもしれないが、それでも底辺に近いわけでもない。

key: The fact that you so consistently wipe the proverbial floor with me is nothing to be sneezed at.
en: The fact that you so consistently wipe the proverbial floor with me is nothing to be sneezed at.
ja: お前が私を、これほど一貫して完膚なきまでにたたきのめすというのは、決して軽視できることではない。

key: Your sister, too.
en: Your sister, too.
ja: お前の姉もな。

key: Every time.
en: Every time.
ja: 毎回だ。

key: You appear to have inherited a talent even I never possessed.
en: You appear to have inherited a talent even I never possessed.
ja: どうやら、私すら持ち得なかった才能を、お前は受け継いだようだ。

key: Must be your mother's, I suppose...
en: Must be your mother's, I suppose...
ja: おそらく、お前の母親譲りなんだろう……

key: I had no idea.
en: I had no idea.
ja: 私には、まったく見当もつかなかった。

key: Do you kids ever play each other?
en: Do you kids ever play each other?
ja: お前たちは、お互いに対戦したりするのか?

key: NOEL: We used to.
en: NOEL: We used to.
ja: ノエル: 昔はしてた。

key: There wasn't much to do at the orphanage.
en: There wasn't much to do at the orphanage.
ja: 孤児院では、他にやることがあまりなかったから。

key: Now there are more options.
en: Now there are more options.
ja: 今は、選択肢がもっとある。

key: RADOMUS: And to think I asked for your help to beat Anna...
en: RADOMUS: And to think I asked for your help to beat Anna...
ja: ラドマス: アンナに勝つために、お前に助けを求めたと思うと……

key: Perhaps I should ask for her help to beat you.
en: Perhaps I should ask for her help to beat you.
ja: お前に勝つために、彼女に助けを求めるべきなのかもしれないな。

key: NOEL: So it was just about her?
en: NOEL: So it was just about her?
ja: ノエル: つまり、目的は彼女だけだったってこと?

key: RADOMUS: On the contrary, you are the one I'm playing with.
en: RADOMUS: On the contrary, you are the one I'm playing with.
ja: ラドマス: いや、むしろ、私が今こうして向き合っているのは、お前だ。

key: To ask for your help was simply an excuse to pass the time together.
en: To ask for your help was simply an excuse to pass the time together.
ja: お前に助けを求めたのは、単に一緒に時間を過ごす口実だったのだ。

key: NOEL: Right.
en: NOEL: Right.
ja: ノエル: そう。

key: RADOMUS: It isn't the most elegant play,
en: RADOMUS: It isn't the most elegant play,
ja: ラドマス: 一番洗練されたやり方ではないだろうが、

key: But then, some fathers make their children go fishing.
en: But then, some fathers make their children go fishing.
ja: 世の父親の中には、子供を釣りに連れて行く者もいる。

key: I can't imagine you'd care for that very much.
en: I can't imagine you'd care for that very much.
ja: お前がそれをあまり気に入るとは思えないがね。

key: I certainly never did...
en: I certainly never did...
ja: 私自身も、まったく好きにはなれなかったし……

key: This seemed much more palatable.
en: This seemed much more palatable.
ja: こちらの方が、ずっと性に合うと思ったのだ。

key: Was I wrong?
en: Was I wrong?
ja: 間違っていたかね?

key: NOEL: I don't know.
en: NOEL: I don't know.
ja: ノエル: わからない。

key: Chess isn't very interesting either.
en: Chess isn't very interesting either.
ja: チェスも、そんなに面白くはないし。

key: RADOMUS: Isn't it?
en: RADOMUS: Isn't it?
ja: ラドマス: そうかね?

key: NOEL: There's a finite number of moves that can be made each turn.
en: NOEL: There's a finite number of moves that can be made each turn.
ja: ノエル: 毎手、打てる手の数は有限だ。

key: It's calculable.
en: It's calculable.
ja: 計算できる。

key: And with modern AI, it's practically a solved game.
en: And with modern AI, it's practically a solved game.
ja: それに、現代のAIがあれば、事実上解かれたゲームだ。

key: RADOMUS: Well, I suppose so...
en: RADOMUS: Well, I suppose so...
ja: ラドマス: まあ、そうかもしれんな……

key: I'll do better next then.
en: I'll do better next then.
ja: それなら、次はもっと工夫しよう。

key: NOEL: It's fine.
en: NOEL: It's fine.
ja: ノエル: いいよ。

key: I don't really mind.
en: I don't really mind.
ja: 別に、気にしてないから。

key: ...Father, what is this hat?
en: ...Father, what is this hat?
ja: ……父さん、この帽子は何?

key: RADOMUS: Ah, can't you tell?
en: RADOMUS: Ah, can't you tell?
ja: ラドマス: ああ、わからないかね?

key: I have to try hard to even stand a chance against you,
en: I have to try hard to even stand a chance against you,
ja: お前に少しでも勝機を得るには、必死にならねばならないのでね、

key: So naturally, I wore my thinking cap!
en: So naturally, I wore my thinking cap!
ja: 当然、これは考える帽子というわけだ!

key: NOEL: ...Snrk.
en: NOEL: ...Snrk.
ja: ノエル: ……ふっ。

key: RADOMUS: Aha! A titter!
en: RADOMUS: Aha! A titter!
ja: ラドマス: おお! 笑ったな!

key: NOEL: ...Perhaps.
en: NOEL: ...Perhaps.
ja: ノエル: ……かもね。

key: RADOMUS: No haps about it!
en: RADOMUS: No haps about it!
ja: ラドマス: 「かも」ではない、確実にだ!

key: 'Twas a snicker, a snirtle-- a twitter!
en: 'Twas a snicker, a snirtle-- a twitter!
ja: くすくす笑いに、ふふっという声――さざめきだったぞ!

key: NOEL: Dad--
en: NOEL: Dad--
ja: ノエル: 父さん――

key: RADOMUS: And what starts with a smirk may evolve past a 'snrk',
en: RADOMUS: And what starts with a smirk may evolve past a 'snrk',
ja: ラドマス: にやりとした笑みから始まり、「ふっ」を通り越して進化し、

key: Into a jeer, a fleer-- maybe a hearty guffaw!
en: Into a jeer, a fleer-- maybe a hearty guffaw!
ja: あざけりに、あざけ笑に――やがては朗らかな大笑いへと!

key: Once a chortle, a chuckle-- someday a hee-haw!
en: Once a chortle, a chuckle-- someday a hee-haw!
ja: ひとたびくすくす笑い、くつくつ笑い――いつかは高笑いへと!

key: A machination of cachinnation-- Crackling, cackling, a massive howl...
en: A machination of cachinnation-- Crackling, cackling, a massive howl...
ja: 大笑いの仕掛けよ――パチパチと、ケラケラと、大きな雄たけびへと……

key: To grin, gibe and giggle-- and laugh jowl to jowl!
en: To grin, gibe and giggle-- and laugh jowl to jowl!
ja: にっこりと、からかいと、くすくすと――ほおを寄せ合って笑い合おうではないか!

key: NOEL: Hahah, okay already...
en: NOEL: Hahah, okay already...
ja: ノエル: ははっ、もういいから……

key: RADOMUS: You've lived too much to have smiled so little.
en: RADOMUS: You've lived too much to have smiled so little.
ja: ラドマス: お前は、これほど笑うことが少ないには、あまりに多くを経験しすぎた。

key: Please forgive your old man for taking pleasure in every snort he can fleece you for.
en: Please forgive your old man for taking pleasure in every snort he can fleece you for.
ja: お前から引き出せる、ほんのわずかな笑い声にすら喜びを感じる、この老いた父を許してくれ。

key: NOEL: You said your father used to take you fishing.
en: NOEL: You said your father used to take you fishing.
ja: ノエル: 父さんのお父さんは、釣りに連れて行ってくれてたって言ってたよね。

key: Will you tell me about him?
en: Will you tell me about him?
ja: その人のこと、話してくれる?

key: RADOMUS: With pleasure.
en: RADOMUS: With pleasure.
ja: ラドマス: 喜んで。

key: RADOMUS: Where to start, I wonder...
en: RADOMUS: Where to start, I wonder...
ja: ラドマス: さて、どこから話したものか……

key: His name was as much a fiction as my own, but for quite different reasons entirely.
en: His name was as much a fiction as my own, but for quite different reasons entirely.
ja: あの人の名も、私自身のものと同じく偽りだったが、その理由はまったく別のものだった。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
